Lower Text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
[When Linking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
Upper Text: If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
